written: 2026-10-02, after review 1 of lane Q5 (artifacts/agent_orchestration/handoffs/Q5-calibration-seeds-review.md); no cell was measured after it and none is planned
kind: erratum: records where the protocol, its addendum 1 or the executed analysis differ in wording or detail. It adds no cell, changes no rule and changes no number of results/summaries/b2-seeds-v1/.

items.stated: every 400-image seed scores 4 to 9 points above the 2000-image calibration for fp6_e3m2, log6 and posit6_es1 (default recipe) on ResNet18 and MobileNetV2
items.correct: the five-seed MEANS are above the 2000-image value by +5.89 (fp6_e3m2) and +4.76 (log6) on ResNet18 and by +5.62, +3.83 and +9.33 (fp6_e3m2, log6, posit6_es1) on MobileNetV2; ResNet18 posit6_es1 is not shifted (seeds 58.91 to 60.90 against 59.595, mean +0.33), and single seeds fall below the 2000-image value in two cases (ResNet18 posit6_es1 S0, S2, S4; MobileNetV2 log6 S2 20.06 against 20.34). Per-seed ranges of seed minus 2000-image value: ResNet18 fp6_e3m2 +2.76 to +8.31, log6 +2.27 to +6.35, posit6_es1 -0.68 to +1.30; MobileNetV2 fp6_e3m2 +3.92 to +7.40, log6 -0.28 to +9.00, posit6_es1 +5.83 to +16.31 (results/summaries/b2-seeds-v1/seed-cells.csv). The addendum's cells and analysis are unaffected; only the motivating sentence overstated the observation.

items.correct: the 36 addendum cell records carry only the v1 protocol sha256 (79c6bbe1...); they are identified as addendum cells by their arm name (addendum_range_only, addendum_bias_only) and their subsets R0..R2 / B0..B2, and by time (10:28Z to 10:44Z, after the addendum file).

items.stated: image variance = mean over seeds of the paired image-bootstrap variance
items.executed: tools/experiment_b2_seeds/analysis.py v1 (sha256 recorded in results/summaries/b2-seeds-v1/summary.json) reports the mean over seeds of the bootstrap SD
items.effect: checked in artifacts/experiment_b2_seeds/checks/review1-checks-v1.json (tools/experiment_b2_seeds/checks.py): over all 54 seed cells and 96 contrasts, both readouts, the protocol's definition changes the image SD by at most 0.018 pp and the seed share by at most 0.12, both in cells at chance level (MobileNetV2 Posit6 minimal, MobileNetV3-Large NF4 minimal, lowest index; top-1 below 0.2 percent). Under expected credit the largest changes are 0.008 pp and 0.033 (MobileNetV3-Large NF4 minimal, at chance). No reported median or conclusion changes; the v1 summaries are kept.

items.where: protocol v1, five-seed rule, zero handling
items.stated: a per-seed difference of exactly zero counts as a sign change against any non-zero seed
items.executed: analysis.py v1 takes numpy.sign of the float per-seed mean difference, so an exact zero could come out as +/-4e-17
items.effect: rechecked in exact rational arithmetic (checks.py): 9 per-seed differences are exactly zero (1 under expected credit, ResNet18 INT8 - Posit8 S3; 8 under lowest index); the sign columns of contrasts.csv (consistent after 3 and 5 seeds, needs five after 3 and 5) agree with the exact evaluation in all 192 contrast-readout pairs (0 mismatches). Counts unchanged: sign changes over five seeds 30 (expected) and 34 (lowest index); five seeds needed 81/84 (expected) and 86/87 (lowest index).
